# arrstack_secret_backend_role (Resource)

Manages a role on the arrstack secrets engine that mints short-lived, scoped arrproxy machine tokens.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Tokens minted from arrstack/creds/sonarr can reach Sonarr only.
resource "arrstack_secret_backend_role" "sonarr" {
  backend = arrstack_secret_backend.arrstack.path
  name    = "sonarr"
  apps    = ["sonarr"]
  ttl     = 3600
  max_ttl = 86400
}

# Read-only: tokens may only send GET and HEAD. Omit methods for unrestricted.
resource "arrstack_secret_backend_role" "sonarr_ro" {
  backend = arrstack_secret_backend.arrstack.path
  name    = "sonarr-ro"
  apps    = ["sonarr"]
  methods = ["GET", "HEAD"]
  ttl     = 3600
  max_ttl = 86400
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `apps` (Set of String) Apps a minted token may reach (non-empty subset of sonarr, radarr, prowlarr).
- `backend` (String) Mount path of the arrstack secrets engine.
- `name` (String) Name of the role.

### Optional

- `max_ttl` (Number) Maximum lease TTL in seconds for tokens minted from this role.
- `methods` (Set of String) Upper-case HTTP methods a minted token is limited to (subset of GET, HEAD, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS). Omit or leave empty for unrestricted.
- `ttl` (Number) Default lease TTL in seconds for tokens minted from this role.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by <backend>/roles/<name>.
terraform import arrstack_secret_backend_role.sonarr arrstack/roles/sonarr
```
